description: Real-time multi-UPS monitoring system with local USB drivers, remote WireGuard agents, interactive WebUI dashboards, and smart Viber alerting.
changelog: Dynamic multi-remote UPS auto-discovery and automatic slot allocation (Remote-1, Remote-2, ...)
Multi-remote UPS profile management in WebUI Settings with custom display names, locations, and rated power
Isolated telemetry and dedicated color coding for individual remote UPS units in Chart.js historical charts
Synchronized multi-unit self-test execution across all active local and remote UPS profiles
Refined harmonious Dark & Light theme color palettes with enhanced contrast and glassmorphism
